name: DateInput
label: Date input
description: Date input with native picker, calendar icon, label, and validation states.

props.name: size
props.description: Component size (not the native character-width `size` attribute)

props.name: error
props.description: Error state: marks the control invalid and, in the older form without `errorText`, recolours the helper text as the error message.

props.name: helperText
props.description: Helper text displayed below the control. With the older `error` flag and no `errorText`, it doubles as the error message.

props.name: errorText
props.description: The error message, shown under the control while the helper text keeps its place. Setting it marks the control invalid, so `error` is not needed alongside it; Field's spec owns the wiring.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description:
Convenience callback receiving the value directly.
Fires alongside `onChange`, which keeps the standard React event signature
so form libraries work unmodified.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes — applied to the wrapper, not the <input>

keys.note: A native date input: the browser owns its keys and its picker.
